name: Chudeng Xiye
source:
The Sage from the Main Beacon, the spiritual leader of the Illuminator society. She is extremely busy with work, handling various affairs of the society every day.

[spoiler]In reality, Bonfia is just an older Illuminator whose appearance does not match her age. She always speaks in a tired and helpless tone, and when facing decisions, she always considers the gains and losses of everyone and the overall interests of Inlixaland.[/spoiler]
translation:
The Sage from the Main Beacon, the spiritual leader of the Illuminator society. She is extremely busy with work, handling various affairs of the society every day.

[spoiler]In reality, Bonfia is just an older Illuminator whose appearance does not match her age. She always speaks in a tired and helpless tone, and when facing decisions, she always considers the gains and losses of everyone and the overall interests of Inlixaland.[/spoiler]
